description: This file implements the RemotePlugin class for a Rust adapter in a WPEFramework plugin, handling socket communication, process management, and JSON-RPC message forwarding.

classes.name: RemotePlugin
classes.description: A class managing remote socket communication, process launching, and JSON-RPC message handling for a Rust plugin in WPEFramework.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up socket connection, and optionally launches a remote process.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, closes socket, and waits for remote process to terminate.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::SendTo
methods.description: Sends a JSON message to a specified channel.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Invoke
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC invocation, forwarding requests over the socket.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Attach
methods.description: Attaches a channel and notifies the remote stream.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Detach
methods.description: Detaches a channel and notifies the remote stream.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound JSON messages, returns a JSONRPC factory object.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::onRead
methods.description: Handles incoming responses from the socket.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::LaunchRemoteProcess
methods.description: Launches a remote process with specified shared library, IP, and port.
